feed_title: Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed Mattress, Large 110 x 85cm, 10cm Deep, Washable Zip Off Cover | PawLunova Buttermere
descriptionHtml:
110 × 85cm. 10cm of memory foam. One size, one job.

Buttermere is a large orthopaedic memory foam dog mattress, 110 × 85 × 10cm, in one size. Foam runs under the whole surface and the cover unzips.

There is probably a bed in your house that nobody sleeps on. It went thin through the middle, or the filling gathered into a ridge, and the dog moved onto the hall floor instead.

Filling does that because it can move. A 10cm sheet of memory foam cannot. It sits under the whole 110 × 85cm surface, right up to the seam.

What they get

  • Memory foam edge to edge: No thin spot at the sides and no stuffing to shift into lumps.
  • 110 × 85cm of open floor: A flat footprint with no bolsters eating into it.
  • A level 10cm edge: They step on from any side rather than climbing.
  • A cover that zips off: It goes in the washing machine. The foam stays out.

Best for: Large breeds, side sleepers, and dogs who shift position all night.

Why it is worth the money

£79 is the least you can spend here and still buy foam rather than filling. It goes into a 10cm memory foam core under 110 × 85cm of open surface, with no bolster to pay for. The core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee on the one part a cheap bed loses first. And you are not gambling the £79. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One size is the honest limit here. A dog who already hangs off a 110cm bed will hang off this one too.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
Large110 × 85 × 10

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

One size only. Hold their length against 110cm and their width against 85cm.

Is 10cm deep enough for a big dog?

It is our shallower foam depth, which keeps the surface level and the price at £79.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

All we can describe is 10cm of memory foam with a level edge. Your vet is the person to ask about your dog.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. It unzips, the cover goes in the machine, and the foam stays behind.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Put it down, step back, and watch where they choose to sleep.
